name: screen_understand
description: Look at any window, region or the whole screen and answer questions about it: 'what does the error on my screen say', 'read the chart in this window', 'summarise what's in this window'. Uses the local OCR (exact text) plus the local vision model (Gemma 3) for what text can't convey. Read-only, free.
route: what does my screen say, read the error on my screen, what's in this window, summarise the screen, read the chart, what am i looking at, analyse my screen, what's on this window
